schema_description: Directory-level resolved bootstrap-CI metadata sidecar. Covers all per-cell evaluation.json files under results/phase3a-text-matrix/**/. Each cell has the same bootstrap specification because they were all produced by scripts/evaluate_detections.py with default parameters.
registry_commit_note: Sidecar written at repository HEAD e038bfe8 on 2026-04-20. Script defaults stable throughout the 2026-04-16/17 generation window.
generation_timestamp_note: Cells generated in several sweeps; mtimes span 2026-04-17. Individual timestamps available from file mtimes.

invocation.source: script default, no run.log in cell directories
invocation.command_shape: python scripts/evaluate_detections.py --detections <per-cell consensus geojson> --buffers 20 30 40 50 --bootstrap 1000 --seed 42 --ground-truth <gold-standard geojson> --bounds <standard 384 bounds>

per_cell_ci_count: 3 metrics (F1, precision, recall) x 4 buffers = 12 CIs per cell
notes: Phase 3a text matrix: 2 instructions (high, minimal) x 4 temperatures (0.0, 0.3, 0.7, 1.0) x multiple N (3, 5, 10, 30). Per-cell evaluation.json files share the bootstrap spec recorded here. Not paper-cited individually; the aggregate all-evaluations.json is the reference point.
